observations.fact: The AI startup offer lists up to $250,000 in year-one credits, followed by 20% coverage up to an additional $100,000 in year two.
Baseten distinguishes up to $25,000 for Dedicated Inference or Training from up to $2,500 for Model APIs.
observations.quoted_value: Up to $25,000 in credits for Dedicated Inference or Training; Up to $2,500 in credits for Model APIs

observations.fact: AWS Activate Portfolio lists up to $200,000 for pre-Series B startups with an Activate Provider Org ID.
